title: It was unclear how many of the 15 holds needed real attention vs. how much was intentionally leave-able; the status screen's 'a hold seen whole is forty to seventy turns' framing helped but I still wasn't sure if partial exploration of a hold (e.g. just its main hollow, skipping side content) counted fully toward 'settled.'
